Buying in San Diego Is Competitive. Here's How I Help.

Buying a home is one of the biggest financial decisions you'll make — and in San Diego, the market moves fast. I help buyers stay informed, move strategically, and avoid the mistakes that come from feeling rushed or underprepared.

The buying process

  1. ONE

    Clarity & Pre-approval

    We start by getting clear on what you want, what you can spend, and what your timeline looks like. If you need a lender, I can connect you with someone I trust.

  2. TWO

    Search & showings

    A focused search with thoughtful showings so you learn quickly, compare options clearly, and move efficiently when the right home appears.

  3. THREE

    Offer strategy

    We craft terms that protect you while staying competitive — including price, contingencies, timing, and negotiation approach.

  4. FOUR

    Inspections & contingencies

    We review disclosures and inspections, then negotiate repairs or credits if needed before moving forward.

  5. FIVE

    Escrow to keys

    I coordinate the deadlines, paperwork, and moving parts so nothing falls through the cracks between acceptance and closing day.

Common buyer questions

Why work with a buyer’s agent?
The listing agent works for the seller — full stop. My job is to work for you. That means helping you figure out if a home is actually worth what they're asking, reviewing disclosures so nothing catches you off guard, structuring an offer that's competitive without overpaying, and staying on top of every deadline through escrow.
Do I need to be pre-approved before I start looking?
Not necessarily, but it helps a lot. Pre-approval tells you exactly what you can spend and makes your offer much stronger when you find the right home. If you're not there yet, we can start with strategy and work on it together.
How much should I offer?
The right offer depends on pricing, competition, condition, and terms. I’ll walk you through a clear strategy so you understand what matters most — and why.
What happens after my offer is accepted?
Once you're under contract, the clock starts. We move into inspections, disclosures, and contingency deadlines — I'll track every date and make sure nothing gets missed between acceptance and closing.
Can you help me compare neighborhoods in San Diego?
Yes — and it's one of my favorite conversations to have. I live in La Jolla, so I know the coastal neighborhoods firsthand. Whether you're weighing La Jolla against Bird Rock, Pacific Beach, or Del Mar, I can walk you through the real differences in feel, value, and what you actually get for the price. Every neighborhood has tradeoffs — I'll help you find the one that fits how you actually want to live.
